facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog post 'StackAdapt joins digital advertising alliance and IAB europe's global vendor list' was published on July 5, 2018.
In 2018, StackAdapt joined IAB Europe's Global Vendor List and established full GDPR compliance, according to the company's own blog post.
facts.quote: Joining IAB Europe’s Global Vendor List and establishing full GDPR compliance

facts.fact: In 2018, StackAdapt joined the Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA) and the Digital Advertising Alliance of Canada (DAAC), according to the company's own blog post.
facts.quote: Joining Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA) and Digital Advertising Alliance of Canada (DAAC)

facts.fact: In 2018, StackAdapt stated it supports AdChoices across the inventory it accesses.
facts.quote: Supporting AdChoices across the inventory we access

facts.fact: StackAdapt stated that GDPR affects only a small part of its business, without giving a specific percentage.
facts.quote: While GDPR affects only a small part of StackAdapt’s business
